lines: 刀锋抵在咽喉的刹那，秦夜笑了。
不是解脱，不是疯癫，是一种极其复杂的、糅杂了恍然、荒谬和冰冷讥诮的笑。
上一刻，他还是屹立于大陆绝巅的“阎罗圣手”秦夜，医道通神，武道称尊，一柄银针可定生死，一套拳掌可镇山河。却因信了最不该信的人，被挚爱道侣联合九大世家、十二洞天布下绝杀之局，围困于断魂崖。血战三日，力竭而亡。
意识沉入无边黑暗前，他只记得那个女人冰冷绝情的脸，和那句：“你的医术武道，你的阎罗殿，还有你这个人，都太让人不安了。所以，请你死吧。”
没想到。
真没想到。
意识再度苏醒，涌入的不是地府幽冥，而是刺眼的阳光、嘈杂的人声、后颈粗糙麻绳的勒痛，以及……脖颈皮肤传来的、鬼头刀特有的铁锈和血腥混合的冰凉触感。
海量陌生的记忆碎片，如同决堤洪水，粗暴地冲进他的脑海。
青云城。
秦家庶子，同名同姓，也叫秦夜。
今年十七。
天生经脉淤堵如顽石，无法修炼，是青云城人尽皆知的第一号废物。
父亲秦啸天，秦家当代家主，对他这个婢女所出的儿子视如草芥。母亲早逝，他在秦家活得不如一条得宠的狗。
昨日，城主府举办百花宴。城主之女，青云城第一美人兼天才，苏清雪，在宴席中途“不慎”跌倒，正好倒向路过的秦夜。秦夜下意识伸手扶了一把。
就这一扶，出事了。
苏清雪当场尖叫，指控他借机亵渎，触碰不该碰的地方。在场的秦家大长老秦烈，为了讨好城主苏远山，二话不说，亲自出手将他拿下，扭送官府。人证“确凿”，秦家“大义灭亲”，城主府“悲痛施压”，半天之内走完全部流程，判了个斩立决。
秦家旋即对外宣告，将此忤逆子弟永久除名，生死与秦家无关。
于是，便有了此刻——午时三刻，断头台上，跪等问斩。
“呵……”秦夜喉间溢出的那声低笑，更浓了几分。好个不慎，好个正好，好个大义灭亲，好个干净利落。
这具身体原主残留的最后情绪，是滔天的冤屈、不甘，以及对这个世界冰冷的绝望。
“兄弟，你这人生，够憋屈的。”秦夜在心底对着那已然消散的原主意识低语，“不过，既然我来了，用了你的身子，那你的冤，你的债，就由我来讨。那些欺你、辱你、弃你、害你的人，一个都跑不了。”
“我，阎罗圣手秦夜，说到做到。”
“喂！那废物……临死前叽叽咕咕什么呢！”粗嘎的喝骂在头顶响起。
秦夜微微抬眼。
一个满脸横肉、敞着怀、胸口一撮黑毛的壮汉，正提着鬼头刀站在他身侧，这是刽子手。刽子手脚边放着个酒碗，他拎起酒坛咕咚咕咚灌了几口，然后“噗”一声，将混着口水的烈酒喷在闪光的鬼头刀上。
酒气混着腥气扑鼻而来。
“小子，记住了，下到阴曹地府，告状的时候报准了名号。”刽子手咧嘴，露出黄黑交错的牙，“害你的是苏大小姐，是秦家大长老，是这青云城的王法！冤有头债有主，别找错了人！”
说完，他举起鬼头刀，阳光在刀锋上反射出刺眼的光斑，晃过台下无数看热闹的眼睛。
台下一片拥挤。贩夫走卒，闲汉婆娘，伸长了脖子，脸上写满兴奋、麻木，或事不关己的唏嘘。
“斩了斩了！这秦家废物，竟敢亵渎苏小姐，死了活该！”
“听说他娘就是个丫鬟，爬了家主的床才生的他，果然下贱胚子！”
“秦家这次倒是果断，大义灭亲啊！”
“啧，苏小姐何等人物，紫阳宗内定弟子，也是这种废物能碰的？剁碎了喂狗都不解恨！”
监斩台就在侧前方。一个留着山羊胡、穿着青色官服的中年人，正襟危坐，面前摆着令箭筒。他就是今日的监斩官，青云城主簿，刘文焕。他眯着眼看了看日头，又瞥了一眼跪在断头台上一动不动的秦夜，脸上没什么表情，只是抬手，从令箭筒中抽出一支红头令箭。
“时辰已到——”刘文焕拖长了腔调，声音尖细。
他将令箭高高举起，然后，朝着秦夜的方向，猛地掷出。
令箭“啪嗒”一声落在断头台木板上。
刽子手闻令，眼中凶光一闪，浑身肌肉贲张，吐气开声：“嘿——！”
鬼头刀划破空气，带着令人牙酸的呼啸，对准秦夜的后颈，狠狠劈落！
台下不少人下意识屏住呼吸，或闭上眼睛，或瞪得更圆。
content_en:
The moment the blade touched his throat, Qin Ye smiled.
It's not relief, it's not madness, it's an extremely complicated smile that mixes suddenness, absurdity and cold sarcasm.
A moment ago, he was Qin Ye, the "Holy Hand of Yama" who stood at the top of the continent. He was a master of medicine and respected in martial arts. A silver needle could determine life and death, and a set of fists could control mountains and rivers. But because he believed in the most untrustworthy person, his beloved Taoist companions, together with the nine aristocratic families and the twelve caves, set up a murderous plan and besieged him in Duanhun Cliff. After three days of bloody fighting, he died of exhaustion.
Before his consciousness sank into the boundless darkness, he only remembered the woman's cold and heartless face, and the words: "Your medical skills and martial arts, your Yama Temple, and you are too disturbing. So, please die."
Unexpectedly.
I really didn't expect that.
When the consciousness came back to life again, what came in was not the underworld, but the dazzling sunlight, the noisy voices, the pain of the rough hemp rope on the back of the neck, and... the cold touch of the unique rust and blood of the ghost head knife coming from the skin of the neck.
A large number of unfamiliar memory fragments rushed into his mind like a flood.
Qingyun City.
The concubine of the Qin family has the same name and surname, and is also called Qin Ye.
This year is seventeen.
He was born with meridians blocked like stubborn stones, unable to practice cultivation, and was known to everyone in Qingyun City as the number one waste.
His father, Qin Xiaotian, the current head of the Qin family, treated him, the son of his maid, as nothing. His mother died young, and his life in the Qin family was not as good as a pampered dog.
Yesterday, the City Lord’s Mansion held a Hundred Flowers Banquet. Su Qingxue, the city lord's daughter, the most beautiful woman and genius in Qingyun City, "accidentally" fell down in the middle of the banquet, and happened to fall towards Qin Ye who was passing by. Qin Ye subconsciously stretched out his hand to give him a hand.
With this help, something happened.
Su Qingxue screamed on the spot, accusing him of taking the opportunity to commit blasphemy and touching places he shouldn't have touched. The eldest elder of the Qin family, Qin Lie, was present. In order to please the city lord Su Yuanshan, he personally captured him without saying a word and sent him to the government. The witnesses were "conclusive", the Qin family "killed relatives for justice", and the city lord's mansion "pressed with grief". The entire process was completed in half a day and the verdict was pronounced.
The Qin family immediately announced that this rebellious son would be permanently removed from the family, and his life and death had nothing to do with the Qin family.
So, here comes this moment - at three o'clock in the afternoon, on the guillotine, kneeling and waiting to be beheaded.
"Haha..." The low laugh that escaped Qin Ye's throat became a little thicker. What a careless one, what a perfect one, what a righteous act of annihilating relatives, what a neat one.
The last remaining emotions of the original owner of this body were overwhelming grievance, unwillingness, and cold despair towards this world.
"Brother, your life is quite frustrating." Qin Ye whispered in his heart to the dissipated consciousness of the original owner, "However, since I am here and I have used your body, then I will take care of your injustice and your debt. None of those who bullied you, humiliated you, abandoned you, or harmed you can escape."
"I, Qin Ye, the Holy Hand of Yama, do what I say."
"Hey! That loser... what was he chirping about before he died!" Rough curses sounded above his head.
Qin Ye raised his eyes slightly.
A strong man with a fleshy face, open arms and a tuft of black hair on his chest was standing beside him holding a ghost-headed knife. This was the executioner. There was a wine bowl at the executioner's feet. He picked up the wine jar and drank a few gulps. Then with a "pop" sound, he sprayed the liquor mixed with saliva onto the shining ghost head knife.
The smell of wine mixed with fishy smell hit my nose.
"Kid, remember, go down to the underworld and give your correct name when you complain." The executioner grinned, showing his yellow and black teeth. "The person who harmed you was Miss Su, the elder of the Qin family, the king of Qingyun City! Every wrong has its owner, and every debt has its owner, don't find the wrong person!"
After speaking, he raised the ghost-headed sword, and the sunlight reflected dazzling spots on the blade, passing through countless watching eyes in the audience.
The audience was crowded. Traffickers and lackeys, idle men and women stretched their necks, their faces filled with excitement, numbness, or sadness that had nothing to do with them.
"Behead him! This Qin family loser dares to blaspheme Miss Su. He deserves to die!"
"I heard that his mother was just a maid who crawled into the master's bed to give birth to him. She is indeed a despicable child!"
"The Qin family is decisive this time and wants to destroy relatives for justice!"
"Tsk, what kind of person is Miss Su? She is an internal disciple of the Ziyang Sect and can be touched by this kind of trash? Even if she is chopped into pieces and fed to dogs, she won't be able to forgive her hatred!"
The execution platform is right in front. A middle-aged man with a goatee and a blue official uniform sat upright, with an order quiver in front of him. He is today's supervisor and chief registrar of Qingyun City, Liu Wenhuan. He squinted at the sun, then glanced at Qin Ye, who was kneeling motionless on the guillotine. There was no expression on his face. He just raised his hand and pulled out a red-headed arrow from the quiver.
"The time has come -" Liu Wenhuan drawled, his voice high-pitched.
He raised the command arrow high, and then threw it violently in Qin Ye's direction.
"Cut——!"
The arrow landed on the wooden board of the guillotine with a "clack" sound.
When the executioner heard the order, a fierce light flashed in his eyes, his muscles tensed up, and he exhaled: "Hey——!"
The ghost-headed sword pierced the air, with a heart-wrenching roar, aimed at the back of Qin Ye's neck, and struck down hard!
Many people in the audience subconsciously held their breath, closed their eyes, or stared wider.
